findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior of the ice machine (baffle) to have a layer of pink mold. Discussed with PIC. PIC cleaned the machine during the inspection. Ensure the interior of the ice machine is routinely cleaned (wash, rinse, sanitize) and particular attention is paid to the baffle. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior baffle of the ice machine to have layer of black mold. Inspector showed PIC/CFPM. PIC began to wash, rinse, sanitize the interior basin of the ice machine. Discussed routine cleaning of the ice machine with PIC. Ensure a schedule is adhered to in order to prevent mold build-up. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs (no longer smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent):
1. Dish machine is new and needs re-caulked to the wall. Inspector showed PIC areas that need re-caulked.
2. The shelf under the dish machine area is heavily rusted. Inspector suggested replacing the shelving under the dish machine due to amount of rust present.
3. The edging of the hot holding steam table needs resealed. The wood is exposed and needs to be painted/sealed. 

Discussed repairs with PIC. PIC was in agreement to have maintenance staff correct these issues. Correct before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 

A large can of product is observed with multiple at or dents on the can rack. Can was discarded during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text:
3-501.17 (A) (Pf) Refrigerated, READY-TOEAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.
Sour cream was observed in the reach in cooler with a marking indicating that it was opened on 4/12. This puts today as day 12th day from opening. The conainer was discarded during the insepction.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) (P): Except during preparation, cooking or cooling, TCS foods shall be maintained at 41 F or less for safety. 

Milk in the milk cooler was observed at 47-48 F (probed). The cooler was observed with an air temperature of 50 F. Investigation revealed that the cooler had been unplugged at some point after lunch yesterday. Not knowing how long the milk had been out of temperature it was discarded and more was acquired from another area of the building.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

Observed a bag lunch stored in the milk cooler. The facility has a location in the walk in cooler designated for person lunches and drinks. Discussed with the PIC and the bag was moved during the inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

There was milk observed puddling in the bottom of the milk cooler. There milk was giving off a sour smell and discussing the issue with the PIC revealed that it had leaked out the day before when the milk delivery was delivered. The milk was cleaned up during the inspection.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the vegetable sink when it is turned on. Repair the sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed a cracked light shield near the back door.  Replace the light shield.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the shelves in the walk in cooler to be heavily rusty.  These shelves shall be a smooth and easily cleanable surface.  Repair or replace the shelves to make them smooth and easily cleanable.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the leak at the vegetable sink when it is turned on.  Repair the sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitizer in sanitizer bucket. 0ppm Cl.  The bucket was remade to show 100 ppm Cl.
750-800c Where equipment and utensils are used for the preparation of  potentially hazardous foods on a continuous or production-line basis, utensils and the food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized at intervals throughout the day on a schedule subject to the approval of the regulatory authority.  This schedule shall be based on food temperature, type of food, and amount of food particle accumulation.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed cans of green beans to be dented on the top and bottom seams.  Cans were pulled during the inspection to be returned.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed parts of tiles missing near the walk in freezer.  One tile is loose and the other is chipping.  Tiles need to be replaced to make them smooth and easily cleanable.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed an absence of caulk near the two compartment sink.  Re-caulk the sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a broken gasket in the reach in cooler near cookline.  Replace gaskets.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
There were several drawers that had chipped paint inside and around the drawers. Re-paint the drawers to they are easily cleanable. 
All shelves need re-painted. Paint is starting to chip away and shelves need to be easily cleanable.
Bottom shelf trim holding pickles and salad dressing is damaged (next to walk in freezer).  Repair shelf.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Foods properly cooled
findings.comment: Observed a medium size pan of spaghetti dated 3/17/2011 to be at 44 degrees F on top and 50 degrees F in the middle when checked with my stem thermometer.  The manager states that they must have put it away in a hurry and it did not cool properly.  The manager voiced understanding about cooling properly and since risk type will be upgraded to a high, cooling and reheating will be allowed, if done properly.  The spaghetti was discarded during inspection.  *Violation Corrected*

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 1210: Drainboard to dishmachine is beginning to pull from the wall and break the caulk. Recaulk the drainboard/sink to the wall so there is no gap. Discussed what materials to use on the large gap - caulk may not be enough.
